text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Wonder Acute!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Do your best—!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, Trainer-san. Looks like the number
of people cheering for me has increased, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Sirius Stakes (G3).
Wonder Acute's steady, unyielding effort was slowly
winning over more and more fans.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was one person watching Wonder Acute
with an intense gaze.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? Trainer,
that person over there is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"She's staring right at me, you know?
With such wonderfully gentle, yet sad eyes..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Could you go take a quick look for me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute couldn't go to the spectator stands. I decided to go watch in her stead.

Ah... You're Wonder Acute's
Trainer, right...?
I'm sorry. I just couldn't help staring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pinned to that chest—
A Trainer's badge gleamed brightly.
choice_data_list: So you were a Trainer, then

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I'm sorry,
I got a little carried away.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute...
That Umamusume is...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She's so similar.
To the Umamusume I used to train.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"I've thought for a while now that we're a lot alike.
So I've been secretly following along."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
And whenever there's a race,
I just can't help going to the venue to watch...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I hope she does well. Seeing her work so hard might
even remind some people of that girl.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho, is that so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I explained the situation, Wonder Acute nodded understandingly...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
People who cheer for someone hold so many different feelings.
It goes far beyond just being a fan...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "Unforgettable feelings, feelings I don't want to forget, so many different emotions..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Right now, I...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My chest feels all warm and glowing.
Not blazing like usual, but gentle-like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A heat distinct from a raging fighting spirit... Umamusume carry many different kinds of passion.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The voices cheering for me...
Even if they aren't as loud as the ones for
Falco-san, they still resonate straight to my heart...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer, today I—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can put in
a really good run. A really great one, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Will you watch over me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'll be watching.
Together with that Trainer.
